segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Hey Priya, quick check on the Northlake quote. They confirmed 42 seats, annual term, and they want the calibration data module included for the April 15 go-live.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Yeah, I saw the pricing sheet. With the module, they're at $38,640 for the year before tax, right?

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Right. I used the mid-market tier and the 8% services discount we talked about. Implementation is 12 hours, flat $2,400.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Okay. Any issue with their net 45 ask?

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: That's the one thing. I've nudged finance and deal desk a few times for the billing term sign-off, and the order form is basically sitting until that comes back.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Got it. If they approve net 45, no other redlines?

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: No, their ops lead was fine with the standard contract. They just need the first invoice to hit after May 1 because their new cost center opens then.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Makes sense. Did they still want training split into two sessions?

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Yeah, two 90-minute sessions. One for lab managers, one for the technicians. I penciled in April 8 and April 10, but told them we'd confirm after signature.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Okay, then once finance clears the term, send it. If they sign by Friday, April 15 is still realistic.
